run_pump_generator: run pump.py on a .pump source file to generate C++ boilerplate code
convert_pump_source: convert pump source text with meta programming directives into generated C++ code
parse_pump_ast: parse pump source text into an abstract syntax tree with variables, ranges, and loops
tokenize_pump_code: tokenize pump source code into tokens including variables, ranges, conditionals, and raw code
beautify_generated_code: beautify generated C++ code by wrapping long lines to 80 characters with proper indentation
